Junglee Music presents 'Parvati (Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati)', a powerful Shiva-Parvati devotional song by Sadhu Tiwari from the film Hanuman Ansh. Dedicated to Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva, this new Hindi bhakti song celebrates the divine bond of Shiv and Parvati, reflecting the strength, determination, and devotion of Maa Parvati. With expressive vocals and captivating music, 'Parvati' brings alive the spiritual essence of Shiv Shakti and the timeless connection between Mahadev and Mata Parvati.

Sadhu Tiwari's heartfelt rendition makes 'Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati' a beautiful addition to your Shiva Parvati songs, Shiv bhajan, and Hindi devotional music playlists. Watch the full video, celebrate the devotion of Maa Parvati, and share this beautiful bhakti song with your loved ones.

snippet.description:
RAMAYANA: RISE OF A LEGEND - only in cinemas, IMAX and Premium Large Formats worldwide November 5. Tickets on Sale now.

Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi. 

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG has worked on films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in cinemas in time for Diwali on November 5.

snippet.description:

Ma Lakshmi’s Panchali is a timeless tradition rooted in devotion and faith. Reciting the Panchali with a sincere heart is believed to bring blessings of happiness, peace, and prosperity. Listen to the full lyrical version of ‘Lakshmi Panchali’, chanted by Pousali Banerjee, only on  @aalosocial .

-------------------------------------------
ଜହ୍ନି ଓଷା - Chapters / Timestamps
00:00 - ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭ ଓ ଜହ୍ନି ଓଷା ବନ୍ଦନା
00:20 - ପ୍ରଥମ ଛାନ୍ଦ (ମହେଶ୍ୱର ଓ ବୃନ୍ଦାବତୀ ଉପାଖ୍ୟାନ)
06:38 - ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଛାନ୍ଦ (ଭାଗୀରଥୀ ଓ ସୁକାନ୍ତି କଥା)
14:33 - ତୃତୀୟ ଛାନ୍ଦ (ପୀତାମ୍ବର ଓ ପ୍ରିୟବତୀ ଉପାଖ୍ୟାନ)
18:32 - ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଛାନ୍ଦ (ଧନେଶ୍ୱର ଓ ଚମ୍ପାବତୀ କଥା)
22:32 - ଜହ୍ନି ଓଷା ପୂଜା ବିଧାନ
24:00 - ପଞ୍ଚମ ଛାନ୍ଦ (ସୌରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଦେଶ ରାଜାଙ୍କ କଥା)
31:33 - ଜହ୍ନିଫୁଲ ଠୋଠା (ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଗୀତ)
36:25 - ତୁଳସୀ / ବୃନ୍ଦାବତୀ ସ୍ତୁତି ଓ ସମାପନ

snippet.title: छलड़े छलड़े बाल | Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi | Krishna Bhajan | Chalrey Chalrey Wal Krishna Version Song
snippet.description:
छलड़े छलड़े बाल | Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi | Krishna Bhajan Female Version | New Radha Krishna Bhajan

Song: छलड़े छलड़े बाल (Krishna Version)
Lyrics: Bunty Thakur
Music & Composer: Bunty Thakur
Singer: Kratika Thakur
Editing & Post Production : Chitrankan Recording Studio
Recording Studio: Chitrankan Recording Studio
Music Label: Bajao Music

🙏 राधे राधे 🙏
शरद पूर्णिमा 2026 के पावन अवसर पर Bajao Bhakti प्रस्तुत करता है "छलड़े छलड़े बाल" का कृष्ण संस्करण — सांवरे सलोने कान्हा को समर्पित एक मधुर Female Version ❤️तू सांवल फूल कस्तूरी" — यह पंक्ति जैसे साक्षात सांवरे सलोने श्याम के लिए ही लिखी गई हो। घुंघराले छलकते बाल, मोरपंख धारी मुकुट, कस्तूरी सा महकता रूप — वृंदावन के नटखट कान्हा की वही छवि इस भजन में उतर आई है। राधा रानी के प्रेम में डूबी यह मधुर धुन आपको सीधे ब्रज की गलियों में ले जाएगी, जहाँ हर साँस में बस एक ही नाम बसता है — कृष्ण।

This is the Krishna version of the trending folk melody, reimagined as a soulful Radha Krishna bhajan in a female voice. "Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi" — the dark-complexioned one, fragrant as kasturi — is the most natural description of Sanwariya Seth himself. Perfect for Sharad Purnima and Raas Purnima, Kartik maas sadhana, Govardhan Puja, Vrindavan bhakti, morning meditation and quiet evening listening. 🦚

🌍 Radha Krishna devotees in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and the Gulf — let this bhajan fill your home with Braj's devotion this Kartik month. 🪔

🦚 यह भजन खास तौर पर इनके लिए :
• शरद पूर्णिमा / रास पूर्णिमा की रात के लिए
• कार्तिक मास की साधना और दामोदर आराधना के लिए

snippet.title: Aajita Kumara Punei Jiba Chanda Bandei ll ଆଜିତ କୁମାର ପୁନେଇଁ ll Pragnyashree Nayak ll Kumar Punei2026
snippet.description:
#Aajita #Kumar #Punei #Ajita #Kunarpunei #Kumarapunei #Special #Song2026 #Pragnyashree #Nayak #Sai #Pragnya #creation #Priyadarshini #Nayak #Muralidhar #Das #Kumar #Punei #Janhago #Phulabaulabeni #Pragnyashreenayaknewsong #Kuanrapunein #Kumarpunei #Saipragnyacreationnewrealse #kumarapurnima #Kuanrapuneinreals #

ଶରତର ମନୋରମ ପରିବେଶ, କାଶତଣ୍ଡୀର ଧଳା ରଙ୍ଗ ଏବଂ ଜହ୍ନର ସୁନେଲୀ ଆଲୋକରେ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଘରେ ଘରେ ପାଳିତ ହୁଏ ପବିତ୍ର 'କୁମାର ପୁନେଇଁ' ବା କୁମାର ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣିମା। ଏହା ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଓଡ଼ିଆ କନ୍ୟାମାନଙ୍କର ଏକ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଗଣପର୍ବ। ଏହି ଦିନ କୁମାରୀମାନେ ସକାଳୁ ସ୍ନାନ କରି ନୂତନ ବସ୍ତ୍ର ପରିଧାନ କରିଥା’ନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଦେବତାଙ୍କୁ ପୂଜା କରନ୍ତି।
​ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ସମୟରେ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ରୋଦୟ ହେବା ପରେ, ସୁସଜ୍ଜିତ ଥାଳିରେ ଖଇ, କଦଳୀ, ନଡ଼ିଆ, ଆଖୁ, ଜହ୍ନି ଓ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାର ଫଳମୂଳ ସଜାଇ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ମାମୁଁଙ୍କୁ ପୂଜା କରାଯାଏ। ଏହି ଦିନ ସମସ୍ତେ 'କୁମାରୀ ପୂଜା' କରିବା ସହ "ଫୁଲ ବଉଳବେଣୀ..." ଗୀତର ତାଳେ ତାଳେ ଟହଳି ଖେଳିଥା’ନ୍ତି। ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ରହିଛି ଯେ, ଏହି ବ୍ରତ ପାଳନ କଲେ ଯୁବତୀମାନେ ସୁନ୍ଦର ଓ ସୁଗୁଣ ସମ୍ପନ୍ନ ପତି ଲାଭ କରିଥା’ନ୍ତି। ଏହି ପବିତ୍ର ପର୍ବ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ଜୀବନରେ ଆନନ୍ଦ, ଉତ୍ସାହ ଏବଂ ସୌଭାଗ୍ୟ ଆଣିଦେଉ।

🎧Singer :: Pragnyashree Nayak 
✍️Lyrics :: Muralidhar Das 
🎶Music:: Priyadarshini Nayak
